state.task:
Question-answering task using the company document service.

The company handbook is held by a document service; it is not available as files. Documents
have a header line (version, status, effective dates, what they supersede) and numbered
sections; each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded
versions, and memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the
situation and date in the question.

Service actions (reply with one of these instead of "execute"):
  {"action": "search", "query": "lodging limit Geneva", "k": 5, "thought": "..."}
      up to k (at most 8; default 5) ranked passages with ids and document headers. Each
      result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (path in the result header),
      where your code can read it later.
  {"action": "fetch", "ids": ["HB-07 §2", "HB-12"], "thought": "..."}
      the named passages in full; a document id ("HB-12") returns all its sections; at most
      10 ids per fetch.
You can still use "execute" for code (for example to read saved results or manage your
context), and "final" to answer.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the paid sick days for an employee with twelve years of service on a fixed-term contract today? (answer in days per year)
- Q2: What is the flight fare limit for a standard return flight within Europe with checked equipment today? (answer in EUR per return flight)
- Q3: What is the paid parental leave for an employee who is the primary carer of a newborn today? (answer in weeks)
- Q4: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR)
- Q5: What is the purchase approval threshold for a regular department's purchase from a supplier with a framework contract today? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What bike-leasing allowance applied to a regular employee leasing a commuter bike on 2026-03-15? (answer in EUR per month)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the rule
and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.step_intent: Find the relocation lump sum that applies to: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request today (2026-10-13)?

passages.source: HB-52 §1 | Memo: relocation lump sum exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-05-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the relocation lump sum in HB-55. Claims for the relocation lump sum are filed in the expense tool under 'HR policy: relocation support'. The HR publishes worked examples of the relocation lump sum on the intranet.

passages.source: HB-11 §2 | HR policy: relocation support — Standard relocation lump sum | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-05-01 to the day before 2026-04-01 · superseded by: HB-55
passages.text: Employees who relocate at the company's request receive a relocation lump sum of 2750 EUR. Each claim for the relocation lump sum needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier. Claims for the relocation lump sum are filed in the expense tool under 'HR policy: relocation support'.

passages.source: HB-55 §2 | HR policy: relocation support — Standard relocation lump sum | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-04-01 · supersedes: HB-11
passages.text: Employees who relocate at the company's request receive a relocation lump sum of 3250 EUR. Claims for the relocation lump sum are filed in the expense tool under 'HR policy: relocation support'. Managers confirm claims for the relocation lump sum before payment in the next payroll run.

passages.source: HB-52 §2 | Memo: relocation lump sum exceptions — Exception for relocations to another country | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-05-01
passages.text: For relocations to another country, the relocation lump sum is 5000 EUR instead of the standard amount. Claims for the relocation lump sum are filed in the expense tool under 'HR policy: relocation support'. The HR reviews the relocation lump sum once a year and announces changes in advance.

passages.source: HB-11 §1 | HR policy: relocation support — Scope | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-05-01 to the day before 2026-04-01 · superseded by: HB-55
passages.text: This version set the relocation lump sum for all employees. Questions about the relocation lump sum go to the HR, who keeps the record of decisions. The HR publishes worked examples of the relocation lump sum on the intranet.
